steps.name: Given a COMPANY user "blocked-company-campaign@lifecycle.test" with consents not accepted
And a session exists for "blocked-company-campaign@lifecycle.test" as COMPANY
When the user sends POST to "/partnership-opportunity" with empty body
Then the response status should be 403

expected 403; response body: {"timestamp":"2026-11-09T09:22:14.250228715","status":403,"error":"Forbidden","message":"You must accept the updated terms to continue using the platform","path":"/api/partnership-opportunity","code":"error.auth.consent_required","requestId":"REQ-7869f72d"}
And the response should have header "X-Consent-Required"
headers: vary, x-request-id, x-consent-required, x-content-type-options, x-xss-protection, cache-control, pragma, expires, x-frame-options, content-type, content-length, date, keep-alive, connection
